subject: Ephemeral credits request for MLBench throughput sweep
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@mlbench.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: mlbench-eng@mlbench.com
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: short-term credits for 48h throughput sweep

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the model latency looks promising. The eng team wants to run a focused 48-hour throughput sweep (simulated traffic with realistic prompt mixes) next week to validate autoscaling and KV-cache behavior under steady high QPS.

Can Redwood top up our trial account with an ephemeral credit bundle just for that window? Rough numbers attached (est_usage_48h.csv) — we expect a peak of ~650 RPS for 6 hours and an average of ~180 RPS across the 48-hour window. This is strictly a validation run; we won't keep running after the window.

If you need an NDA/PO or anything else on file, let me know. We'd like to start as early as Tue 21 Sep 00:00 UTC if possible.

Appreciate the help — Alex

--
Alex Chen
Head of Infrastructure
MLBench Inc.
alex.chen@mlbench.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@mlbench.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: short-term credits for 48h throughput sweep

Team — looping you in. MLBench wants a one-off ephemeral credit bump for a controlled 48-hour throughput sweep starting Tue 21 Sep (UTC). Attached they sent an updated test plan (mlbench_testplan_v2.pdf) and estimated usage.

Key asks I want us to sign off on before committing:
- Credit amount: align to the attached estimate (looks like ~$7.8k of usage at our hosted rates).
- Window: 48 hours, strict start/end.
- Guardrails: auto-throttle if 95th p95 > 350ms or if daily spend > 2x estimate.
- Data handling: confirm the run uses their test dataset only, and is excluded from eval/metrics aggregation.

Stephanie — is the $7.8k within promo/top-up budget for trials?
Vivek — need final approval for the one-off credit grant and the guardrail limits above.

Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: short-term credits for 48h throughput sweep

Thanks for the context, Aditya. I reviewed the est_usage_48h.csv and the numbers line up with what we typically authorize for mid-stage POCs. A few notes:

- Promotional budget: we can cover up to $9k one-off for trial-led POCs (falls inside program limits).
- Approval path: ok to approve at PM level for up to $9k; CCing Vivek for final sign-off on policy exception (guardrails).
- Operational ask: please require MLBench to run via a named test project so we can isolate billing and disable automatic quality-capture pipelines.

If Vivek gives the green light, I'll route the credit and send the simple acceptance terms to Alex (one-paragraph agreement, no DocuSign required).

Stephanie

Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@mlbench.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: short-term credits for 48h throughput sweep

Approved. Conditions documented below — please confirm to Alex and schedule the credit window:

1) Grant $8,000 ephemeral credit to MLBench account RDW-MLB-2027-09. Credit valid exactly 2027-09-21 00:00 UTC -> 2027-09-23 00:00 UTC.
2) Enable auto-throttle: terminate or pause requests if cluster p95 exceeds 350ms for two consecutive 15-minute intervals.
3) Billing isolation: run under project tag "mlbench-throughput-sweep-2027-09" and exclude from quality telemetry ingestion.
4) If usage hits >110% of the attached estimate before the window end, notify sales and infra ops; we reserve the right to suspend.

Aditya — please confirm the mechanics and drop the short acceptance email to Alex (I don't need a formal DocuSign). Monica, please coordinate on the project tag and telemetry exclusion.

Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
